project.visitorDecision: Compare two actual NOAA NDBC buoy observations, including their age, before independently consulting marine forecasts and warnings.
project.primaryAction: Select two NDBC stations and inspect their individual official station reports and the NWS marine forecast.

claims.subject: observed-buoy-readings
claims.limitation: NDBC station reports are time-stamped point observations with sensor-specific coverage, not marine forecasts or boating clearance.

claims.subject: significant-wave-height
claims.limitation: Wave-height reports at separate stations do not describe individual breaking waves, shoreline conditions or unobserved transit routes.

claims.subject: safe-boating-decision
claims.limitation: The page cannot establish that any craft, route or shoreline location is safe based only on two buoy measurements.

claims.subject: missing-wave-measurement
claims.limitation: When one or both station wave sensors are unavailable, no numerical wave difference is displayed.

decisionState.selectedIdField: station.id for independent A and B selectors
decisionState.sourceOfTruth: The existing enriched NDBC /api/buoys station array and per-station obs_time; observation-bridge.js computes the paired view.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: When API or map fails, preserve the static NOAA answer, a compact map fallback, the source-linked station list and explicit snapshot/older-report status.

scenarios.input: Select recent station 45029 and recent station 45005
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Compare each measured significant wave height and show the measured difference with both observation times and source links.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Neither measurement certifies a route, beach or boat departure.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The A station measurements, relative bar and comparison message follow 45187; B stays 45005.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Selected IDs and observed times are independent; do not infer transit conditions.

scenarios.input: Select 45029, change A to 45187, then return to 45029
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Restore the original 45029 to 45005 observed difference and each linked source.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Never retain a stale pair's value after selection.

scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Existing authored NOAA static answer and NWS marine source are still readable; the new selectors are disabled.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: No claim of live observations without the client data feed.

scenarios.input: Block third-party Leaflet scripts and basemap tiles
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: The map falls back to a compact source-linked station-list notice; selectors and list remain interactive.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: Map failure cannot become inferred station geolocation or a blank 560px panel.

scenarios.input: Fail the API and use old inline snapshot
scenarios.expectedVisibleAnswer: Page explicitly labels saved snapshot, suppresses positive live advisories and refuses a current wave difference.
scenarios.sourceAndSafety: An old snapshot is never described as currently reporting.

failures.no-js: Retain SEO/HTML-first NOAA explanation and official station and marine forecast links without requiring JS.
failures.no-tiles: Collapse unavailable map and keep populated station list and paired observation controls.
failures.no-image: The experience is an instrument comparison with no new imagery or photographic assertion.
failures.stale-data: Show saved snapshot/older observations and avoid a positive advisory or confident wave difference.

qa.scopeNote: Browser workflow now executes isolated NDBC fixtures and blocked-CDN tests; results must be verified at the exact head. Live CARTO tiles and production ads are not reproduced in the fixture.

verificationLimit: This draft records the code and planned acceptance. Until exact-head browser CI and full repository CI are verified, do not mark release verified, deployed or live. A passing fixture does not prove public marine data, map tiles, CTR or revenue impact.
